'''James Zajic kill off the dark jedi''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[James Zajic]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21568">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21568 kill off the dark jedi], DeckTech (James "dabora" Zajic, 19 February 2002).
